```{r}
palette_df <- read.csv("metadata/clean/project_palette.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
palette <- setNames(palette_df$color, palette_df$label)
```

## Data import
```{r}
taxa_df <- read.csv("processed_data/genus_ra_non_rare.csv")
colnames(taxa_df) <- colnames(taxa_df) %>% gsub(".*g__","",.)
taxa_df %>% head()

taxa_df_raw <- read.csv("processed_data/genus_ra_pre_batch_merge_non_rare.csv")
colnames(taxa_df_raw) <- colnames(taxa_df_raw) %>% gsub(".*g__","",.)
```

```{r}
mdata_all <- read.csv("metadata/clean/core_metadata_with_mean.csv") %>% 
         mutate(phenotype_binary = ifelse(phenotype %in% c("Classical FAP", "Non-classical FAP"), "FAP", "Control"),
                phenotype_binary = factor(phenotype_binary , levels = c("FAP", "Control")),
                gender = ifelse(gender == "Female", 1,0))
patient_mdata <- mdata_all %>% select(-sample_id, -batch) %>% unique()
mdata <- mdata_all %>% filter(sample_id %in% taxa_df$sample_id)
mdata %>% head()
```


# Analysis
## Taxonomic composition

### Identify patients with 2 samples
```{r}
patients_cross_batch <- mdata %>% filter(batch == "Mean RA") %>% pull(patient_id)
mdata_subset <- mdata_all %>% 
                mutate(patient_id_base = patient_id,
                       patient_id = ifelse(patient_id %in% patients_cross_batch,
                                           paste0(patient_id, " (",gsub("Batch ","", batch),")"),
                                           patient_id)) %>%
                select(sample_id, phenotype, phenotype_binary, patient_id, patient_id_base, is_surgery)
```

### Phylum level
```{r}
path <- paste0("qiime/combined/6_Taxonomy_GTDB/feature_table.tsv")
relab<- read.table(path , header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
colnames(relab) <- format_sample_ids(colnames(relab))
relab_phy <- relab %>% mutate(phylum = gsub(".*p__","",taxon),phylum = gsub(";c__.*", "", phylum)) %>% 
             filter(phylum != "") %>% select(-taxon) %>% group_by(phylum) %>% summarise_all(sum) %>% ungroup() %>% 
             column_to_rownames("phylum") %>%  mutate_all(~ . / sum(.)) %>% 
             t() %>% as.data.frame()

relab_phy_mean <- apply(relab_phy, 2, mean)
non_rare_phyla <- relab_phy_mean[relab_phy_mean > 0.01] %>% names() %>% sort()
```

```{r}
ggdata <- relab_phy %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "ra") %>% 
          mutate(taxon = ifelse(taxon %in% non_rare_phyla, taxon, "Other")) %>%
          group_by(sample_id, taxon) %>% summarise(ra = sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>%
          left_join(mdata_subset,by = "sample_id")

tmp_palette <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9,name = 'RdYlGn'))(length(non_rare_phyla))
names(tmp_palette) <- non_rare_phyla
tmp_palette["Other"] <- "grey"

ggdata <- ggdata %>% mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = c(non_rare_phyla, "Other")))
```
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=20, fig.align='center'}
ggp <- plot_abundance_barplot(ggdata, tmp_palette) +
facet_wrap(~phenotype_binary, scales = "free_x", ncol =1) + theme(legend.position = "none")
plot(ggp)
```


```{r}
ggdata_for_boxplot <- ggdata %>% filter(taxon != "Other") %>% 
                      mutate(patient_id = gsub(" .*","",patient_id)) %>%
                      group_by(phenotype_binary,phenotype, patient_id, taxon) %>% summarise(ra = mean(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>% unique()
```

```{r}
# Perform Mann-Whitney test in a for loop
results_df <- data.frame(taxon = character(), p_value = numeric())
for (phylum in non_rare_phyla) {
  test_data <- ggdata_for_boxplot %>% filter(taxon == phylum, phenotype != "Fatty Liver")
  test_result <- wilcox.test(ra ~ phenotype_binary, data = test_data)
  results_df <- rbind(results_df, data.frame(taxon = phylum, p_value = test_result$p.value))
}
results_df %>% add_significance()
```
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=12, fig.align='center'}
ggplot(ggdata_for_boxplot %>% filter( phenotype != "Fatty Liver"),
       aes(x = taxon, y = ra, fill = phenotype_binary, color = phenotype_binary)) + 
       plot_box_and_jitter(palette) + 
       labs(x = "Phylum", y = "Relative abundance", fill = "Phenotype")
```


```{r}
calculate_phyla_ratio <- function(df,  num, denom){
  phyla_ratio <- df %>% filter(taxon %in% c(num, denom)) %>% 
                 mutate(phyla_group = ifelse(taxon %in% num, "numerator", "denominator")) %>% 
                 group_by(patient_id,phenotype_binary,phenotype, phyla_group) %>% summarise(ra = sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>%
                 tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = phyla_group, values_from = ra) %>% 
                 mutate(ratio = numerator/denominator)
  return (phyla_ratio)
}
```



```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4, fig.align='center'}

num <- c("Firmicutes")
denom <- c("Bacteroidota")

res <- calculate_phyla_ratio(ggdata_for_boxplot, num, denom) %>% 
       mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = c("Classical FAP","Non-classical FAP","Fatty Liver","Control")))

fap_ratio <- wilcox_test_by_pair(res %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver"), "phenotype_binary", "ratio ~ phenotype_binary", FALSE) %>% mutate(cat = "ratio")
fap_num <- wilcox_test_by_pair(res %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver"), "phenotype_binary", "numerator ~ phenotype_binary", FALSE) %>% mutate(cat = "numerator")
fap_denom <- wilcox_test_by_pair(res %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver"), "phenotype_binary", "denominator  ~ phenotype_binary", FALSE) %>% mutate(cat = "denominator")

rbind(fap_ratio, fap_num, fap_denom) %>% add_significance()

ggp_fap <- ggplot(res %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver"), aes(phenotype, log2(ratio), fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + 
             plot_box_and_jitter(palette) +  
            labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "log2[ Pylum Ratio ]", subtitle = "FAP vs Control")
plot(ggp_fap)

```

```{r}
regressors <- c("bmi", "age", "gender")

ggdata <- res %>% mutate(patient_id = paste(patient_id, "Cohort")) %>% left_join(patient_mdata) %>%
          mutate(ratio =log2(ratio)) %>% 
          select(all_of(c(regressors, "ratio", "phenotype_binary", "phenotype")))
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height = 4}
results <- test_wilcox_residuals(ggdata %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver"), regressors,"ratio", "phenotype_binary")
p1 <- results[[1]]
print(paste("Wilcoxon test p-value:", round(results[[1]],10)))
results[[2]] + scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  labs(x = "Phenotype") + scale_x_discrete(limits = c("FAP", "Control"))
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height = 4}
results <- test_wilcox_residuals(ggdata %>% filter(phenotype_binary != "FAP"), regressors,"ratio", "phenotype")
p2 <- results[[1]]
p.adjust(c(p1,p2))
print(paste("Wilcoxon test p-value:", round(results[[1]],10)))
results[[2]] + scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  labs(x = "Phenotype") + scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Fatty Liver", "Control"))
```


```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4, fig.align='center'}
liver_ratio <- wilcox_test_by_pair(res %>% filter(phenotype_binary != "FAP"), "phenotype", "ratio ~ phenotype", FALSE)
liver_num <- wilcox_test_by_pair(res %>% filter(phenotype_binary != "FAP"), "phenotype", "numerator ~ phenotype", FALSE)
liver_denom <- wilcox_test_by_pair(res %>% filter(phenotype_binary != "FAP"), "phenotype", "numerator ~ phenotype", FALSE)
rbind(liver_ratio, liver_num, liver_denom) %>% add_significance()

ggp_liver <- ggplot(res %>% filter(phenotype_binary != "FAP"), aes(phenotype, log2(ratio), fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) +
             plot_box_and_jitter(palette) + 
             labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "log2[ Pylum Ratio ]", subtitle = "Fatty Liver vs Control")
```

### Genus level
```{r}

ggdata <- taxa_df_raw %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "genus", values_to = "ra") %>% 
          left_join(mdata_subset,by = "sample_id")

genera <- ggdata$genus %>% unique() %>% sort()
rare_taxa <- ggdata %>% group_by(sample_id, is_surgery,phenotype_binary,phenotype, patient_id_base, patient_id) %>%
                summarise(ra = 1-sum(ra)) %>% ungroup %>% mutate(genus = "Other")
ggdata <- rbind(ggdata, rare_taxa)

tmp_palette <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9,name = 'RdYlGn'))(length(genera))
names(tmp_palette) <- genera
tmp_palette["Other"] <- "grey"

ggdata <- ggdata %>% mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = c(genera, "Other")))
```
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=20, fig.align='center'}
ggp <- plot_abundance_barplot(ggdata, tmp_palette, fill_var = "genus") +
facet_wrap(~phenotype_binary, scales = "free_x", ncol =1) + labs(fill = "Genus")
plot(ggp)
```

## Alpha diversity
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10, fig.align='center'}
label_order <- c("Control", "Non-classical FAP", "Classical FAP") %>% rev()
shannon_index <- vegan::diversity(taxa_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), index = "shannon")
shannon_df <- data.frame(sample_id = names(shannon_index),shannon = shannon_index) %>% 
  left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id") %>% mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))

wilcox_test_by_pair(shannon_df, "phenotype", "shannon ~ phenotype", FALSE) %>% add_significance()

ggp1 <- ggplot(shannon_df, aes(phenotype, shannon, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + 
  plot_box_and_jitter(palette = palette) +
  labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "Shannon Index", fill = "Phenotype") 

ggp2 <- ggplot(shannon_df, aes(phenotype, shannon, fill = is_surgery, color = is_surgery)) + 
  plot_box_and_jitter(palette = palette) + theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "Shannon Index", fill = "Surgery", color = "Surgery")
plot(ggp1 + ggp2)
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8, fig.align='center'}
shannon_df <- shannon_df %>% mutate(surgery_type = factor(surgery_type, levels = rev(c("No surgery", "Subtotal colectomy", "Pouch"))))
p3 <- ggplot(shannon_df, aes(phenotype, shannon, fill = surgery_type, color = surgery_type)) + 
  plot_box_and_jitter(legend_position = "right", palette = palette) + 
  labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "Shannon Index", fill = "Surgery Type", color = "Surgery Type") 
plot(p3)
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height = 4}
results <- test_wilcox_residuals(shannon_df, regressors,"shannon", "phenotype_binary")
print(paste("Wilcoxon test p-value:", round(results[[1]],10)))
results[[2]] + scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  labs(x = "Phenotype") + scale_x_discrete(limits = c("FAP", "Control"))
```

## Beta diversity
```{r}
  genus_dist <- vegan::vegdist(taxa_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), method = "bray") %>% 
                as.matrix() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")
  tmp <- genus_dist %>% left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id")
  bd <- vegan::betadisper(d = as.dist(tmp %>% select(tmp$sample_id)), group = unname(tmp$phenotype), bias.adjust = TRUE)
  abd <- anova(bd)
  pbd <- vegan::permutest(bd, permutations = 999)
  print(abd)
  print(pbd)
```
```{r}
res <- get_permanova(disct_metadata = mdata,  
                      dist_matrix = genus_dist,
                      dist_metric_name = "Bray-Curtis",
                      sample_id_column = 'sample_id', 
                      metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype"),
                      fdr_threshold = 0.1,
                      pcoa_fill = palette) 
```
```{r}
res$plots[["phenotype_pc1&pc2"]] + 
           labs(fill = "", title = "", color = "") 
```


## Differntial abundance 
```{r}

mdata <- mdata %>% mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))
diff_ra_results <- run_analysis_diff_abundance(taxa_df, mdata, palette, 
                           metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype_binary"),
                           metadata_cols_fix_effects = c(),
                           metadata_cols_rand_effects = c(), 
                           boxplot_x_order = label_order)


```

```{r}
fix_vars <- c("age", "bmi", "gender")
plot_list <- list()

## Compare Control subjects to FAP patients from both classical and non-classical FAP
fap_vs_non_fap <- get_differential_abundance(taxa_df, mdata %>% mutate(phenotype_binary = factor(phenotype_binary, levels = c("FAP", "Control"))),
                                             metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype_binary"),
                                             metadata_cols_fix_effects = fix_vars)
plot_list[["FAP vs Control"]] <- fap_vs_non_fap$plots
fap_vs_non_fap <- fap_vs_non_fap$all_results %>% mutate(contrast = "FAP vs Control")

## Compare Classical and non classical FAP patients
within_fap <- get_differential_abundance(taxa_df, mdata %>% filter(phenotype != "Control"), metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype"),
                                         metadata_cols_fix_effects = fix_vars)
plot_list[["Classical vs Non-classical FAP"]] <- within_fap$plots
within_fap <- within_fap$all_results %>% mutate(contrast = "Classical vs Non-classical FAP")

## Compare Classical and non classical FAP patients (subset of patients who went through surgery)
within_fap_w_surgery <- get_differential_abundance(taxa_df, mdata %>% filter(is_surgery), metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype"),
                                                   metadata_cols_fix_effects = fix_vars)
plot_list[["Classical vs Non-classical FAP (surgery)"]] <- within_fap_w_surgery$plots
within_fap_w_surgery <- within_fap_w_surgery$all_results %>% mutate(contrast = "Classical vs Non-classical FAP (surgery)")

# Prepare data for plotting
ggdata <- prepare_maaslin2_for_volcano(rbind(within_fap,  fap_vs_non_fap, within_fap_w_surgery), metadata_vars = c("phenotype_binary", "phenotype"))
signif_labs <- ggdata %>% filter(is_highlight) %>% pull(label) %>% unique()
```


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=18}
ggp<- ggplot(ggdata %>% filter(is_highlight) , aes(feature, contrast,  color = color)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = -log10(FDR))) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.4)) + 
      scale_color_manual(values = palette) + #scale_y_reverse() + 
      labs( y = "Contrast", x = "Genus", color = "Enrichment group")
plot(ggp)
```


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=18}

      scale_color_manual(values = palette) + #scale_y_reverse() +
```

```{r}

                  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "feature", values_to = "ra") %>%
```
